lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You haven't complained once since we started.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Complaint changes nothing. Movement changes something.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You read the land well. That ridge line — you clocked it before I did.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Spent three years in worse terrain.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Fear arrives. Monks greet it and keep walking.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You rely on the shot. I rely on the step. Neither is wrong.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: As long as one of us reaches the target.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: When you meditate, what do you think about?
